description.default: 🔓 Open source · Finally finish what you read — and what you write: progressive reading digests long-form input day by day, progressive writing queues your material into finished drafts — excerpts, slicing, cloze, flashcards, writing books & compile-to-draft. A full loop from reading to writing.
description.zh_CN: 🔓 已开源 · 让长文读得完，让作品写得完：渐进阅读消化输入，渐进写作排队产出——摘抄、分片、挖空、闪卡、写作书素材入槽、汇编成稿，从阅读到写作的完整闭环
